name: Onboarding checklist
about: Checklist for a new contributor to get started
labels: docs
---

## Onboarding Steps
- [ ] Read README (dev run) and run backend/frontend locally
- [ ] Read AGENTS (rules) and WORKFLOW (DoD/AC/Issues)
- [ ] Create a test Issue using a template; propose AC
- [ ] Propose a short plan (3–7 steps) and wait for approval
- [ ] Implement scoped changes; run JS/Py tests
- [ ] Open PR with verify steps; link Issue (Fixes #id)
- [ ] Update docs if behavior changed
- [ ] Suggest 1–2 process improvements (optional)
